messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]

- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- As of 2025-12-05, the pager for the reporting service rings the Ember team instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- On 2026-04-14 the Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- The reports pipeline must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- The reporting service is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-12-05, having moved from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
    earlier: The reporting service is owned by the Dune team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- Dashboards and alerts for the product catalog are being repointed as of the 2025-12-19 handover. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- On 2025-12-25 the Atlas team noticed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- On 2025-09-02 the Atlas team decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds. [decision; valid 2025-09-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-02]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2026-06-04 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- The indexer was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder, until ownership transferred to the Boreal team on 2026-04-01. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes. [constraint; valid 2025-01-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-31]
- Dashboards and alerts for the image resizer are being repointed as of the 2025-11-26 handover. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
